- Validate input: ensure n is a non-negative integer; define base cases fib(0)=0 and fib(1)=1; decide behavior for n=0 (consistent with Fibonacci definition).
- Implement an iterative approach with O(1) space and O(n) time: loop from 2 to n, maintaining two variables for previous two Fibonacci numbers and updating them.
- Optionally optimize: for very large n, consider fast doubling method (O(log n)) to avoid linear time; include docstring examples as tests.
